name: Cupertino (United States)
description: Navy blue field charged at the centre with the white city emblem, a rectangle bearing a Spanish morion helmet over rays with the words EST. 1955, above the name CUPERTINO.
history: Cupertino is a city in Santa Clara County, California, directly west of San Jose; the morion recalls the Spanish explorers led by Juan Bautista de Anza and 1955 is the year of incorporation.

features.role: emblem with a morion helmet, EST. 1955, above the name CUPERTINO
